snippet.title: Music Game Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4013260/Music_Game/

Overview:
A customisable rhythm game which includes a level editor, Steam Workshop support, automatic level generation and much more!

Key Features:
17 official levels
Manual level editor
Automatic chart generation from uploads
Steam Workshop for sharing levels
Online leaderboards
Local multiplayer (2 Players)
Controller support
Audio-reactive visuals
Custom level folders
Steam achievements
